description: PahaarPulse Knowledge-Base Manifest for Backboard RAG Assistant

documents.title: Why Do Landslides Happen? Understanding the Signals Before Failure
documents.summary: Overview of physical mechanisms, slope equilibrium, rainfall infiltration, and environmental indicators driving landslides.
documents.author: LRM Research Team
use_cases: Pore-water pressure and shear strength explanations

documents.title: How GIS Turns Terrain Data into Landslide Risk Maps
documents.summary: Detailed explanation of GIS layers (DEM, slope, aspect, curvature, drainage) and multi-criteria overlay modeling for hazard maps.
documents.author: LRM Research Team
use_cases: Digital Elevation Model and slope derivative queries

documents.title: How Machine Learning Predicts Landslide Risk: From Data to Probability
documents.summary: Architecture of predictive models, XGBoost probability estimation, clustering, and PahaarPulse's three-layer machine learning pipeline.
documents.author: LRM Research Team

documents.title: Why Rainfall and Soil Moisture Matter for Landslide Risk
documents.summary: Role of short-duration intensity vs. long-duration accumulation, subsurface soil saturation, and multi-variable sensor monitoring.
documents.author: LRM Research Team

documents.title: Watching the Landscape from Space: Satellites and Landslide Monitoring
documents.summary: Remote sensing applications, optical multispectral vegetation monitoring (NDVI), SAR deformation tracking, and satellite limitations.
documents.author: LRM Research Team
use_cases: Remote sensing and Earth observation methods

documents.title: From Risk Maps to Early Warning: What Happens After Prediction?
documents.summary: Distinction between susceptibility, hazard, and risk; transition from static maps to dynamic threshold alerts and disaster mitigation.
documents.author: LRM Research Team
use_cases: Terminology differences (susceptibility vs hazard vs risk)
Early warning thresholds and alert workflows

documents.title: NDMA National Landslide Risk Management Strategy Guidelines
documents.summary: Official statutory guidelines for landslide risk governance, zoning, mitigation, and response in India.
documents.author: National Disaster Management Authority (NDMA), Government of India
documents.license: Government Open Data / Public Sector Guidance (Pending Formal Verification)
use_cases: State and district level disaster management compliance
documents.review_notes: Pending acquisition and hash verification of official PDF release from NDMA portal. Content has not been fabricated.

documents.title: GSI Standard Operating Procedure for Landslide Susceptibility Mapping
documents.summary: Geological Survey of India national landslide inventory and macro-scale susceptibility zoning methodology.
documents.author: Geological Survey of India (GSI)
documents.review_notes: Awaiting official repository inclusion and licensing terms confirmation.

documents.title: Community Landslide Preparedness and Evacuation Handbook
documents.summary: District-level community guidelines for pre-monsoon preparedness, emergency kit assembly, and village warning sirens.
documents.author: State Disaster Management Authority (SDMA)
documents.review_notes: Candidate identified during Phase 1 audit; pending formal intake.

documents.title: Raw Telemetry & Soil Sensor Timeseries Dump
documents.summary: Raw numeric timeseries sensor readings from field piezometers, rain gauges, and moisture probes.
documents.author: Field IoT Deployment
documents.review_notes: REJECTED: High-frequency numeric timeseries tabular data is unsuitable for semantic RAG document indexing. Query via analytical SQL/APIs instead.

documents.title: Automated Weather Ingestion Worker Execution Logs
documents.summary: Debug and operational log traces from weather scraping and cron workers.
documents.author: Automated Worker
documents.review_notes: REJECTED: Ephemeral operational log data containing noisy system traces is unsuitable for knowledge retrieval.
